requests.title: Keep the heat on the dayside
requests.author: orac
requests.rationale: You describe Kestrel's inner worlds as tidally locked, one face always to the star. With no day and night the heat a world absorbs is not spread over the whole sphere. A redistribution factor of 1/2 (dayside only) instead of 1/4 (whole sphere) models that. It raises equilibrium and surface temperatures for every world this flow serves.
